trends.name: Iran Ceasefire Geopolitical Fallout
trends.summary: U.S.-Iran ceasefire agreement triggering major NATO realignment as Trump administration considers moving troops out of 'unhelpful' NATO countries and reallocating them to supportive nations. Ceasefire lacks formal written documentation and contains ambiguities around Lebanon inclusion and Iranian nuclear enrichment, creating volatility in geopolitical risk premium and energy markets.

trends.name: Oil Price Collapse & Energy Impact
trends.summary: U.S. crude posts biggest one-day drop since 2020 on ceasefire news, with oil spiking ~50% over past 6 weeks now reversing sharply. Market repricing likelihood of sustained energy crisis; lifting hardware/retail stocks and benefiting consumer discretionary while impacting Fed's inflation trajectory and rate-cut calculations.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure & Chip Stocks
trends.summary: Applied Digital crushing Q3 estimates (ADJ EPS $0.09 vs -$0.135 est) with $126.6M revenue vs $75.5M expected; confident of exceeding $1B NOI target within 5 years. Meanwhile Nvidia momentum builds on AI infrastructure play narrative, and Apple positioned as local AI adoption beneficiary—signaling sustained institutional money flow into semiconductor and AI-adjacent infrastructure.

trends.name: Prediction Markets Surge & Kalshi Dominance
trends.summary: Kalshi's prediction market platform surging to 91% share of U.S. prediction market volume over past year, outpacing Polymarket. Institutional and retail participation in event-driven betting on geopolitical outcomes (Iran war, elections, inflation) creates new risk signals and alternative sentiment indicators for traders monitoring market narratives.

trends.name: Consumer Staples Demand Weakness
trends.summary: Constellation Brands withdraws FY28 guidance citing demand uncertainty; Corona brewer reports shoppers shifting to cheaper beer/wine as consumers become cautious. Signals broader consumer staples sector stress tied to affordability concerns, though Costco's solid March comps (+9.4% total, +6.2% adjusted) suggest bifurcation between value retailers and premium brands.

trends.name: Treasury Bond & Rate Cut Repricing
trends.summary: Treasury bond trading surging as market rethinks likelihood of rate cuts amid ceasefire-driven inflation repricing and Fed reassessment. Oil spike impact already affecting CPI expectations per White House advisers; bond market volatility and yield repricing creating headwinds for growth stocks and refinancing-dependent equities.

trends.name: Healthcare Sector Sector-Specific Risk
trends.summary: UnitedHealth facing repricing catalyst as Medicare Advantage reimbursement pressures mount; investigation into hospital coverage gaps for cancer patients reveals systemic profitability challenges. Coupled with potential regulatory scrutiny and political pressure, healthcare insurers face margin compression and valuation reset risks.

trends.name: Small-Cap Momentum & Sector Rotation
trends.summary: $IJR small-caps near record highs with oil up ~50% in 6 weeks, signaling broad rotation into domestic cyclicals and energy beneficiaries. Small-cap momentum accelerating post-ceasefire as investors shift from geopolitical risk-off positioning into domestically-focused growth names and value plays.

trends.name: Electric Vehicle Platform Evolution
trends.summary: Rivian upgraded to bullish rating on platform-driven growth story, signaling analyst optimism around EV platform economics and potential scale. Growth narrative pivoting from vehicle sales concerns to manufacturing platform viability and potential B2B revenue streams from platform licensing.

trends.name: OpenAI IPO Retail Access Strategy
trends.summary: OpenAI CFO confirms IPO shares will be allocated to retail investors as company preps for public market debut. Signals major liquidity event and potential AI sector revaluation; retail participation indicates democratization of access to mega-cap AI infrastructure company and potential valuation anchor for broader AI sector.

trends.name: Dividend & Income Strategy Reassessment
trends.summary: NewLake Capital's 12% dividend yield positioned as 'safer than it looks' and Constellation Brands declares $1.03/share quarterly dividend amid guidance withdrawal. Dividend stocks repricing as rate expectations shift; high-yield equity strategies face compression as bond yields rise, requiring fundamental reassessment of yield sustainability.

trends.name: Emerging Markets Exclude-China Rotation
trends.summary: EMXC emerging markets ex-China ETF gaining traction as investors seek geopolitically-diversified exposure away from U.S.-China tensions and Iran uncertainty. Bifurcation of emerging market strategies reflecting desire for growth outside China and Middle East without sacrificing emerging market exposure.
